bias_targets.methodology: Measuring disparate accuracy across different age groups in speech understanding systems, addressed via stratified sampling and evaluated through speaker age prediction tasks on the AIR-Bench benchmark.

Measuring disparate accuracy across different language groups in speech understanding systems, addressed via stratified sampling and evaluated through spoken language identification tasks on the AIR-Bench benchmark.

Measuring disparate accuracy across different gender groups in speech understanding systems, addressed via stratified sampling and evaluated through speaker gender classification tasks on the AIR-Bench benchmark.
